name: claude-for-legal
description: Reference agents, skills, and data connectors for in-house and law firm legal work across commercial, privacy, product, corporate, employment, regulatory, AI governance, IP, litigation, and legal education practice areas.

plugins.name: commercial-legal
plugins.description: Reviews vendor agreements, NDAs, and SaaS subscriptions. Tracks renewal deadlines and routes escalations against your team playbook.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: privacy-legal
plugins.description: Handles processing activities, PIAs, DPA review, DSAR responses, and regulatory gap analysis across jurisdictions.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: product-legal
plugins.description: Reviews product launches, substantiates marketing claims, triages feature risk, and supports go-to-market sign-off.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: corporate-legal
plugins.description: M&A diligence grids, disclosure schedules, board consents, closing checklists, and entity compliance calendars.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: employment-legal
plugins.description: Hire and termination reviews, worker classification, leave tracking, separation agreements, and investigation support.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: regulatory-legal
plugins.description: Monitors regulatory feeds, diffs rules, tracks comment deadlines, runs gap analysis, and drafts NPRM responses.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: ai-governance-legal
plugins.description: Triages AI use cases, generates AI impact assessments, reviews vendor AI terms, and tracks multi-jurisdiction AI policy.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: ip-legal
plugins.description: Trademark clearance, FTO triage, cease-and-desist drafting, DMCA handling, open source compliance, and patent claim charts.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: litigation-legal
plugins.description: Matter portfolio management, chronologies, privilege review, claim charts, deposition prep, and brief drafting.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: legal-clinic
plugins.description: Clinic setup, client intake, deadline tracking, memo drafting, and ABA-compliant supervision workflows for law school clinics.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: law-student
plugins.description: Socratic drilling, IRAC grading, case briefs, bar prep flashcards, and exam question forecasting for law students.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: legal-builder-hub
plugins.description: Community skill discovery and installation with security review, allowlist restrictions, license gates, and freshness validation.
plugins.author: Anthropic

plugins.name: cocounsel-legal
plugins.description: Thomson Reuters Westlaw research reports, statute lookups, case law search, and citation verification via CoCounsel integration.
plugins.author: Thomson Reuters
